name: Ancestry

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: You can select a standardized ancestry feat in place of an ancestry feat whenever you gain an ancestry feat if you meet its prerequisites and if it's listed among the standardized ancestry feat options for your ancestry. These feats have the uncommon trait as a reminder that they are only available if an ancestry's entry specifically lists the standardized ancestry feat as one that is available for that ancestry. The ancestry trait represents whatever ancestry your character is.
